items.title: ECB's Lagarde says Europe needs common rules for tokenized securities before platforms split
items.why: A single EU rulebook would set the terms Freehold has to meet to offer tokenized assets to European investors, and whether those tokens can settle across venues.

items.title: Democratic SEC nominee wants the tokenization exemption turned into a formal rule
items.why: A full US rulemaking with public comment would set the terms, and the timing, for how Freehold can offer tokenized assets to American investors.

items.title: Injective says tokenized mortgage loans on its network now exceed $1.5 billion
items.why: Onchain real estate volume keeps flowing into loans rather than property shares, so Freehold's fractional ownership model still has to prove its own demand.

items.title: Tokenized real estate is still under 1% of tokenized assets, and RealT is in liquidation
items.why: Freehold is opening with collectible cars before property, and this tally shows the ground it is entering: fractional real estate tokens remain a very small category where rivals such as RealT have already shut down.

items.title: BNB Chain leads RWA holder counts while Base, Solana and Stellar grow faster
items.why: RIO trades on BNB Chain, so a growing crowd of RWA holders there is a larger audience for whatever Freehold lists, although the figures count wallets and not people.

items.title: Canadian Securities Exchange pilots tokenized private real estate with Ocree and Apex
items.why: Freehold wants to be where issuers tokenize property, and here an established exchange and a large fund administrator test the same thing on rails investors already use, with secondary trading planned next.

items.title: Japan-listed ASIAN STAR plans to tokenize Japanese real estate on BNB Chain
items.why: Tokenized property from a listed company is coming to BNB Chain, where RIO also trades, which raises the bar Freehold will be compared against when it opens real estate issuance.

items.title: OKX and ICE set a November 23 launch for their tokenized stock venue under the SEC exemption
items.why: Derek says stocks are coming to Freehold, and this venue shows both the SEC route for tokenized shares and how many issuers refuse to have their stock tokenized.

items.title: Securitize plans to buy River One to add asset-backed finance to its tokenization business
items.why: Securitize competes with Freehold for issuers, and pairing tokenized assets with stablecoin lending is a credit layer Freehold does not offer yet.

items.title: Morgan Stanley buys digital transfer agent Vinyl Equity as a tokenization building block
items.why: Big banks are buying the shareholder registry layer to capture issuers at listing, the same issuer onboarding position Freehold's Tokenization Studio is trying to win.

items.title: ARK files for a tokenized market infrastructure ETF
items.why: ARK's proposed fund would back listed tokenization platforms, the category Freehold competes in, but it would not hold network tokens like RIO directly.

items.title: Groma's tokenized real estate goes live in a permissioned Uniswap pool
items.why: Groma competes with Freehold for real estate issuers, and a public trading venue for permissioned property tokens is the secondary liquidity Freehold still has to build.

items.title: Morgan Stanley among the first banks to tokenize US stocks and Treasuries via DTCC
items.why: Wall Street is tokenizing on its own private rails, which validates the model Freehold sells but shows the biggest issuers may not need public-chain platforms like Realio.
